outline:
本課程藉由跨領域合作，配合設計思考課程、及在地產業、藝師等產業接軌協作，引導學生發掘與分析產業與市場需求，進行產品開發與服務活動設計，培育大學生社會責任。
In this course, students will develop their ability to identify and analyze industry/market requirements, product development and service design skills, and sense of university social responsibility. Methods employed include interdisciplinary cooperation, design-thinking training, and collaborations with local industries and craft professionals.
schedule:
第1週工具與方法介紹
第2-4週 問題定義與需求理解
第5-7週 資料蒐集與情境分析
第8-12週 創意發想與概念設計
第13-16週 原型製作與測試
第17週 成果展示與產業回饋
第18週 檢討與活動
scorePolicy:
(A) 設計前研究(問題定義與需求理解10%、資料蒐集與情境分析20%

resources:
● 參與式創新教學 (Participatory & Innovative Teaching)
強調學生參與與產出，導入翻轉、PBL/專題、設計思考或遊戲化等策略。
Emphasizes student engagement and outcomes by adopting strategies such as Flipped Classroom, PBL (Problem/Project- Based Learning), Design Thinking, or Gamification.
● 數位教材資源應用 (Application of Digital Resources)
採用影音多媒體或具開放授權之資源（如OCW、開放教科書）作為主要或輔助教材。
Adopts multimedia or open-licensed resources (e.g., OCW, Open Textbooks) as primary or supplementary teaching materials.
